skills.label: Close Day
skills.description: End-of-day check-in. Logs your effort, focus blocks and what you shipped into today's daily note, with a short reflection.
needs: Today's daily note (press Plan Today first)

skills.label: YouTube Search
skills.description: Searches YouTube and returns videos with views, channel size, and how far each one outperformed its channel.
needs: A YouTube Data API key (YOUTUBE_API_KEY in ~/.claude/.env)

skills.label: Claudex Route
skills.description: Recommends which model should take a task, and can hand one scoped piece of work to it.
needs: Claude Code or Codex (both, for a second opinion from the other one)

skills.label: Claudex Loop
skills.description: Hardens a plan before you build: scouts the project, questions the decisions that matter, then has Codex review the plan until it holds.
needs: Claude Code and Codex, both signed in

skills.label: Codex Build
skills.description: Hands a written plan to Codex to implement, then reviews the full diff and runs the checks.
